f1.title: Name your brand
f1.label: Brand name
f1.helper: This is what guests see on tickets and your page.
f1.sessionTitle: Sign in again to keep going

f2.title: Where will you collect funds?
f2.body: Pick the country your bank account is in. Prices and payouts use its currency.
f2.footnote: Payouts go to a bank in {{country}}, in {{currency}}.
f2.cantPayOut: Mingla can't pay out there yet
f2.locked: Payouts are already set up for a bank in {{country}}. To use another country, disconnect payments first.
f2.forbidden: Only the brand owner or an admin can change the bank country.
f2.conflict: This was changed on another device to {{country}}.

f3.title: Get paid
f3.terms: I agree to the Mingla Organiser Terms
f3.termsHint: Tick the Organiser Terms to continue.
f3.stripeBody: On the next screen you'll add your ID and bank details. Have them ready.
f3.returnedIncomplete: You left before finishing. Pick up where you stopped.
f3.notOwner: Only {{owner}} can set up payments. We've added it to their Home.
f3.waitingClient: Waiting for {{client}} to accept and add bank details
f3.trust: Your bank details go straight to our payment partner. Mingla never sees them.

f4.checkingBody: We're checking them. This usually takes a few minutes. You can keep going.
f4.actionNeeded: One more thing is needed before you can take payments:
f4.ngDone: Bank connected. You're ready to sell.
f4.makeFirst: What do you want to make first?

common.thisBrandDeleted: This brand was deleted on another device.
common.noAccess: You no longer have access to set up {{brand}}.
common.thisBrandNoAccess: You no longer have access to set up this brand.

n1.title: You have a brand in progress
n1.body: {{brand}} isn't finished yet. Pick up where you stopped, or discard it and start a new one.
n1.oneAtATime: You can have one brand in progress at a time.
n1.confirmBody: Its name and setup progress will be deleted. This can't be undone.
n1.confirmBodyPayments: Its payment setup will be closed too.
